description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Texas Statutes, Texas state law, by citation, or of the TEXAS CONSTITUTION: "Tex. Const. art. XVI, sec. 50" is code "CN", section "16.50" (homestead protection; the (a)(7) reverse-mortgage exception is inside it). "Texas Penal Code 19.02" is code "PE", section "19.02" (murder). Returns the statutory text and its amendment history. Keyless. Use for "what does Texas Penal Code 19.02 say", "text of Tex. Fam. Code 6.001", or to check a Texas statute a case relies on.

article.description: Only for code "CN": the article, as a number or Roman numeral ("16" or "XVI"), when section carries just the section number.

code.description: Texas code abbreviation, e.g. "PE" (Penal), "FA" (Family), "CP" (Civil Practice and Remedies), "TX" (Tax), or "CN" for the Texas Constitution. Call tx_codes to see them.

section.description: Section as cited, e.g. "19.02" or "6.001". The chapter is the part before the dot. For code "CN" it is article.section, e.g. "16.50" (Article 16, Section 50) or "XVI.50".

name: tx_statute
title: Tx Statute
